svg.title: Stream-WAM action overlap and conditioning timeline
svg.desc: A static spacetime diagram of AC-Stream. A zero has 32 actions. After the first eight actions, observation O one launches inference while actions 8 through 15 continue. Those eight actions are shared with the first eight positions of A one. At handoff, execution resumes at A one action 8. Eight known action slots and eight unknown slots condition the next visual future.
